Codeflash - Code Editor & IDE

Features of Codeflash
Codeflash aims to provide its users with the best possible experience. Here are some of its features:

👀 Supports over +200 file types.
👀 Completely offline—no internet required.
👀 Handles over 1,000,000 lines of code seamlessly with real-time feedback.
👀 Test your web projects with features like an emulator, desktop mode, box model, and browser preview.
👀 Boost productivity with auto-completion, code folding, and syntax highlighting.
👀 Recycle bin.
👀 Includes Web, JavaScript, and Python code examples.
👀 Offers over 40 editor themes.
👀 Light, Dark, and Night Mode app themes.
👀 Show/Hide line numbers.
👀 Unlimited undo and redo for your code.
👀 Extra floating keyboard for faster coding.
👀 Extensive documentation archive.
👀 Free and internet-free special documents support
👀 Completely free.

Languages that Codeflash can run:
+ HTML
+ CSS
+ JavaScript
+ TypeScript
+ Markdown
+ Python
+ SVG
+ JSON
+ Text

Codeflash provides syntax highlighting and auto-completion for over 200 code file types — here are some of them:
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, C, C++, Java, C#, Kotlin, Ruby, SQL, PHP, Ruby, Pascal and More...

With every update, Codeflash continues to improve, providing an even better coding experience.

📩 For support and feedback, contact: alonewolfsupp@gmail.com
